name: Measure and Integration
description:
Riemann Integral: A brief review of the Riemann integral and its limitations; Lebesgue’s method for extending the Riemann integral.
The Lebesgue Measure on the Real Line: Outer measure induced by the length function; Carathéodory’s criterion for measurability; Lebesgue measurable sets in R; existence of non-measurable sets in R.
Abstract Measure Spaces: General construction of measures and outer measures; extension of a pre-measure to a measure; uniqueness of the extension; completion of a measure space; measurable functions; convergence of measurable functions (almost everywhere, in measure, in mean, and almost uniformly) with respect to a measure; Fatou’s Lemma, the monotone convergence theorem, and dominated convergence theorem; L^p spaces. 
Measure and Integration in Product Spaces: Construction of product measure spaces; integration over product spaces; Fubini’s and Tonelli’s theorems.
Fundamental Theorem of Calculus for the Lebesgue Integral: Absolutely continuous functions; differentiability of monotone functions; the fundamental theorem of calculus for the Lebesgue integral and its applications.
